mcq_drop.why: oddly worded: 'gender-budget scheme' label is not an exam fact

patterns: APPSC asks direct identification: launch year (PMAY-U 2015), threshold figures (ESI wage limit Rs 21,000), state behind a scheme (Vishwakarma Pension = Rajasthan).
Scheme-objective matching (PMAY-U / PMKVY / Ujjwala / Ayushman) and 'which feature is INCORRECT' about PM-JAY (largest, not second largest; Rs 5 lakh cover).
Ministry-celebration trivia appears (6th Rashtriya Poshan Maah 2023) and tagline questions ('One Nation-One Scheme' = PMFBY).
App MCQs are heavier on multi-statement sets with recent 2025-26 figures (EPF ceiling, Labour Codes, UPS); PYQs stay with stable launch years and limits.
